content: The sky is the daily bread of the eyes.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Just as the body requires bread, the aesthetic soul requires the vast, ever-shifting ceiling of the sky to maintain its sense of wonder and freedom.
practicalInsight: Look up at the open sky for two minutes today and let its vast expanse quiet your narrow mental worries.
reflectionPrompt: When was the last time you truly gazed at the clouds or stars with unhurried awe?
